summary: Keep netinst DNS through Debian network setup and stop safely if installer components fail

guide.reason: The graphical installer now stops with visible diagnostics instead of exposing Debian's component menu after a backend failure; netinst recovery instructions describe DNS loss before partitioning.

api.reason: Local wizard networking, Debian netcfg, partman preflight and GTK display change; no Controller operation, Core command, observed-state result or client-facing API contract changes.

roadmap.reason: This repairs an installation variant without changing a platform milestone status.

state.reason: The saved resolver is temporary installer state and creates no durable pool or Controller record.

verification.method: Reproduce the published ISO failure, then install and first-boot a corrected temporary overlay in disposable UEFI VMs; run focused regressions and inspect the graphical failure screen.
